title: console: a refused package publish shows only "Publish blocked by N validation error(s)", never the errors the server returned
body:
Filing gate **③ a task the maintainer set**: objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, the maintainer's browser pass of 2026-10-20. Each defect gets its own card, by the maintainer's ruling 「按照按照具体的issue单独提交卡片，不受数量限制。」 (recorded on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2188, `6283467378`). This is finding **F-08** of track 2 (Setup as the system administrator), by the cloud tester `session_01VuXyJvhGKJy8qeUvhKyxzv`. It was measured on HotCRM `main` `f22dfa52` with `@objectstack/*` 18.0.0-next.5, in Chromium at 1440×900 on a locally booted, seeded install. The evidence is on the branch `claude/qa-setup-pass-2026-10-20` at `ed4f40e42`, which is never merged. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 (`os-support-ai`, session `session_01KqkTQNLcxVc588eZpJmp1r`). ⛔ Not a claim. Grade: triage's.

**Reader (who acts):** objectui triage routes it. Paths under `src/` are HotCRM's (objectstack-ai/hotcrm).

## The finding, as measured

- **Persona / URL:** dev admin, Packages → a new writable package sheet.
- **Actual:** Publish → `200` with `success:false`, `validationErrors:[{"message":"No metadata items found for package …"}]`; the sheet shows only "Publish blocked by 1 validation error(s)." Adopt loose items sends no request and shows nothing.
- **Evidence:** [`02-apps-packages-qa-publish.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-qa-publish.png), [`02-apps-packages-qa-adopt-loose-items.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/hotcrm/blob/ed4f40e42b8b6ce059a4e648f25f8f6037ffd9f6/qa/2026-10-20-setup-pass/shots/02-apps-packages-qa-adopt-loose-items.png).
- **class: a.** **Reach:** admins authoring packages.
- **Suspected landing:** objectstack `console` packages component.
- **Dedupe words:** publish blocked validation errors message hidden, adopt loose items no feedback.

## Seat review

- **Scope:** this card is the publish half only. The finding's second half, "Adopt loose items gives no response", is **not filed**. The seat's review found that the action first opens a native `window.confirm` (`PackagesPage.tsx:720`), and an automated browser dismisses native dialogs unless told to accept them. That half is unverified.
- **Landing (seat review):** objectui `PackagesPage.tsx:524-528` renders only the count of `validationErrors`.

## Dedupe

Method: semantic `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack and objectstack-ai/objectui, open and closed, using the finding's own dedupe words and a second phrasing; plus a grep of every issue title (objectstack #1–#24751, objectui #7–#13153) listed through the repo-scoped `issues?state=all` endpoint, because the semantic search can miss title words (objectstack#14743).
- 0 + 0 hits in objectstack, 0 + 4 in objectui. objectui#11922 (closed 2026-10-08) fixed the `failed[]` list only. **New.**
